question: Should imsg core expose `imsg contact-card` and `contacts.*ContactCard` as built-in bridge surfaces while current macOS proof shows contact-card sharing is unavailable and must fail closed?
rationale: This is a new privacy-sensitive private-API surface rather than a repair of existing documented behavior, and the implementation deliberately advertises a partial surface while avoiding the blocking private controller path.

options.title: Accept guarded core surface
options.body: Keep the proposed CLI/RPC shape and treat fail-closed unavailability as the supported initial contact-card behavior.

options.title: Defer or narrow the surface
options.body: Keep the PR draft or ask for a status-only or external approach until maintainers want contact-card probing in core.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded core surface
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed CLI/RPC shape and treat fail-closed unavailability as the supported initial contact-card behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current release baseline and recent bridge/RPC maintenance, so they are the best available product-direction owner from inspected history.
